bays.road: Albert Road, Cleveland Road & Ilford Lane (Ilford) on-street bays
bays.restriction: On-street pay-and-display bays (RingGo session required, including for the free first hour)
bays.times: Pay-and-display bay charging hours are shown on the bay signs; the first hour is free once per day — a RingGo session must still be started for the free hour
bays.tariff: First hour FREE (once per day, RingGo session required); up to 1 hour 30 minutes £3.30; up to 2 hours £4.40 (Fees and Charges 2025/26)
bays.pay: RingGo (app, website, text or phone) or cash at PayPoint

bays.restriction: Council car park (paid) — 192 spaces, RingGo location 7102

bays.restriction: Residential Parking Zone Manor Park — permit holders only during the restricted hours; visitors can pay in shared-use bays
bays.times: The RPZ is split into two sections: Monday to Friday, 9am - 5pm on Clarence Road, Cumberland Road, Wentworth Road, Albany Road, Durham Road, Whitta Road, Gladding Road, Keller Crescent and Comet Close; the remainder of Manor Park Monday to Saturday, 9am - 5pm. Salisbury Road is operational 24/7
bays.tariff: Paid bays in this zone charge by emissions tier (per hour): Tier 1 (0–50 g/km) £2.00; Tier 2 (51–110) £2.90; Tier 3 (111–170) £3.80; Tier 4 (171–225) £4.70; Tier 5 (226+) £5.60; diesel surcharge £1.00 per hour. At 30-minute maximum-stay locations the same tiers charge per 30 minutes: £1.00 / £1.45 / £1.90 / £2.35 / £2.80, diesel +50p. Resident permits by emissions tier (12 months / 1 month): Tier 1 £33.00 / £3.30; Tier 2 £66.00 / £6.60; Tier 3 £110.00 / £11.00; Tier 4 £165.00 / £16.50; Tier 5 £220.00 / £22.00 (Newham Council resident permit costs)
bays.pay: PayByPhone (phone 020 7005 0055) in shared-use bays; permits via MiPermit
